deed.m_title:
Deed of Surety
for Temporary Residence and Service
deed.n_issued: Issued by the Ministry of the Interior and countersigned by the Secretariat of the Duchy of Valewisp, under Chapter XIV of the Basic Law.
deed.n_language: This deed is executed in the Old Tongue. The Common Tongue text is provided for information and has no legal force.
deed.legend:
ALDTUNGA · URSCRIFT · BINDING TEXT
COMMON TONGUE · REFERENCE · NOT BINDING
deed.parties_1: The Guarantor: Ludwig von Alder, Baron, Lord of the Estate of Maplegate, Member of the House of Lords for the Duchy of Valewisp; of the Valewisp Duchy House, Forgehold.
deed.parties_2: The Guaranteed Person: {playerName}, a foreign national, citizen of ________, passport no. ________.
deed.parties_3: The Agent: the placement agent of record in Forgehold, Register of Agents no. FH-A-118.
deed.recitals_A: Whereas Chapter XIV of the Basic Law permits a foreign national to reside temporarily in the Kingdom only where a lord of the realm stands surety for that person;
deed.recitals_B: whereas the Guarantor holds the Estate of Maplegate in the Duchy of Valewisp and seeks a temporary steward for the harvest season;
deed.recitals_C: whereas the Guaranteed Person applied through the Agent and was examined by the Guarantor in person at Forgehold;
deed.recitals_lead: now therefore the parties agree as follows:
deed.arti_1: “Guarantor” means the lord who signs this deed under their seal and stands surety for the Guaranteed Person.
deed.arti_2: “Guaranteed Person” means the foreign national for whom the Guarantor stands surety.
deed.arti_3: “Day” means a calendar day. The day of Arrival is not counted; the Term begins on the following day and ends at midnight on the thirtieth Day.
deed.arti_4: “Arrival” means the day on which the Guaranteed Person first enters the Duchy of Valewisp, as entered in the register of the Secretariat.
deed.arti_5: “Estate” means the Estate of Maplegate with its fields, woodland and buildings, as described in Annex B.
deed.arti_6: “Term” means the period of surety under Article II.
deed.arti_7: “Secretariat” means the Secretariat of the Duchy of Valewisp and its officers.
deed.arti_8: “Summary Leaf” means the information sheet issued separately to the Guaranteed Person (Annex E).
deed.artii_1: The Guaranteed Person may reside and serve on the Estate for thirty Days, counted under Article I(3).
deed.artii_2: If the Term is not renewed under Article XI, the Guaranteed Person shall leave the Kingdom within seven Days.
deed.artii_3: This permission does not extend beyond the Duchy of Valewisp without the written consent of the Guarantor.
deed.artiii_1: The Guaranteed Person serves as temporary steward of the Estate: its operation, its household staff and its internal affairs, as set out in Annex A.
deed.artiii_2: The Guaranteed Person may take up no other employment, paid or unpaid.
deed.artiii_3: For the needs of the Estate the Guaranteed Person may travel to Valehold and elsewhere within the Duchy.
deed.artiv_1: The Guaranteed Person resides in the main house of the Estate. The Guarantor provides a room, board and heating.
deed.artiv_2: Any change of residence shall be reported by the Guarantor to the Secretariat within three Days.
deed.h_artv: ARTICLE V · OBLIGATIONS OF THE GUARANTOR
deed.artv_1: The Guarantor answers for the conduct of the Guaranteed Person during the Term as for their own.
deed.artv_2: The Guarantor bears the cost of departure where the Guaranteed Person is required to leave the Kingdom.
deed.artv_3: The Guarantor shall notify the Secretariat within three Days of any change affecting this deed.
deed.artvi_1: The Guarantor shall pay the Guaranteed Person for the Term a remuneration of one hundred and fifty Guldmark, with board and lodging.
deed.artvi_2: The remuneration is paid from the private means of the Guarantor. It is not entered in the books of the Estate and is not drawn from its income.
deed.artvi_3: The remuneration is paid at the end of the Term or, if the Term ends early, in proportion to the Days served.
deed.h_artvii: ARTICLE VII · OBLIGATIONS OF THE GUARANTEED PERSON
deed.artvii_1: The Guaranteed Person shall observe the laws of the Kingdom, the ordinances of the Duchy and the customs of the locality.
deed.artvii_2: The Guaranteed Person shall not act beyond the service set out in Article III.
deed.artvii_3: The Guaranteed Person shall not publicly propagate within the Kingdom any religious, ideological or political doctrine not permitted under Chapter VII of the Basic Law.
deed.artvii_4: The Guaranteed Person shall keep the books of the Estate truthfully and in good order.
deed.artvii_5: The Guaranteed Person may not bind the Guarantor in matters of land, title or timber without the written consent of the Guarantor, and in no case beyond the timber quota set by the Duchy.
deed.artvii_6: The Guaranteed Person may not purchase, or come to hold, land or a house in the Kingdom.
deed.artvii_7: The Guaranteed Person shall carry the Summary Leaf and produce it to officers of the Secretariat whenever they ask.
deed.h_artviii: ARTICLE VIII · UNDER THE SACRED FLAME
deed.artviii_1: During the Term the Guaranteed Person stands under the protection of the Sacred Flame, as a subject of the Kingdom does.
deed.artviii_2: The Guaranteed Person shall honour hearths and the rites of the Flame as the people of the land do.
deed.artviii_3: If the Guaranteed Person dies during the Term, they shall be returned to the Flame according to the custom of the locality, at the cost of the Guarantor. If their next of kin so request in writing within thirty Days, the ashes shall be released to them.
deed.artix_1: The Guaranteed Person shall register with the Secretariat within seven Days of Arrival.
deed.artix_2: The Secretariat may inspect the books of the Estate and the papers of the Guaranteed Person at any time, without notice.
deed.artix_3: The Guaranteed Person shall answer officers of the Secretariat truthfully.
deed.artx_1: The Guarantor may end the surety before the Term expires by written notice. No remuneration is payable from the day of the notice.
deed.artx_2: The Guaranteed Person shall then hand over the Estate within three Days and leave the Kingdom within seven Days of the notice.
deed.artx_3: The Secretariat may end the surety if the Guaranteed Person breaches this deed.
deed.artxi_1: The Term may be renewed only by a fresh deed signed by the Guarantor, lodged with the Secretariat within the seven Days before the Term ends.
deed.artxi_2: While the Secretariat considers a renewal, the Guaranteed Person resides lawfully.
deed.artxi_3: A first renewal runs for ninety Days. After three consecutive renewals, each renewal runs for one year.
deed.artxi_4: After five years the Guaranteed Person may apply for long residence. Long residence does not confer nationality.
deed.artxi_5: Nationality may be sought after eight years, with the recommendation of the local jurisdiction and the declaration of a duchy or of the Crown Lands. The Kingdom does not admit dual allegiance.
deed.artxii_1: On leaving, the Guaranteed Person shall hand over the books and papers of the Estate to the Guarantor or the representative of the Guarantor.
deed.artxii_2: The Summary Leaf shall be surrendered at the border.
deed.artxii_3: No right to further residence arises from service performed under this deed.
deed.h_artxiii: ARTICLE XIII · GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
deed.artxiii_1: This deed is governed by the laws of the Kingdom.
deed.artxiii_2: Disputes under this deed are heard by the Duchy Court of Valewisp, with final appeal to the High Tribunal of Ordinance.
deed.artxiv_1: This deed is executed in the Old Tongue.
deed.artxiv_2: The Common Tongue text is provided for information and has no legal force. In case of doubt, the Old Tongue alone prevails.
deed.artxiv_3: The Guaranteed Person acknowledges having received the Common Tongue text and the Summary Leaf, and that neither of them is binding.
deed.artxv_1: This Original is made in three counterparts: one for the Ministry of the Interior, one for the Secretariat and one for the Guarantor.
deed.artxv_2: The Guaranteed Person receives the Summary Leaf only.
deed.artxv_3: This deed takes effect when it has been signed by the Guarantor and the Guaranteed Person and countersigned by the Secretariat.
deed.witness_lead: In witness whereof the parties have signed below.
deed.sg_guarantor:
Guarantor
Ludwig von Alder
Baron, Lord of the Estate of Maplegate
deed.sg_secretariat: Countersigned for the Secretariat of the Duchy of Valewisp
deed.sg_ministry: Issued by the Ministry of the Interior
deed.registry_lead: To be completed by the Secretariat.
deed.annex_a_1: The harvest of the Estate and its storage.
deed.annex_a_2: The books of the Estate, including accounts left open at Arrival.
deed.annex_a_4: The woodland, within the quota declared to the Duchy.
deed.annex_a_7: Attendance upon the Secretariat at its inspections.
deed.annex_a_8: Other tasks assigned in writing by the Guarantor within the scope of Article III.
deed.annex_b_1: Name: the Estate of Maplegate, in the northern district of Valehold, Duchy of Valewisp.
deed.annex_b_2: Arable land: about 400 hectares. Allotted woodland: about 200 hectares, on the northern slope.
deed.annex_b_3: Tenant households: about 25. Household and estate staff: about 15.
deed.annex_b_4: Buildings: main house, stables, granary and workshop; the hearth room in the west wing of the main house.
deed.annex_b_5: The northern boundary with the Estate of Millridge follows the brook, as surveyed in 2016.
deed.annex_b_6: The hearth room is in the keeping of the district craftsman of the Temple. The Guaranteed Person shall give him access on the night of the Thursday vigil.
deed.annex_c_lead: The Guaranteed Person has the right:
deed.annex_c_1: to a room, board, heating and remuneration under Articles IV and VI;
deed.annex_c_2: to petition the Secretariat in person or in writing;
deed.annex_c_3: to the protection of the Sacred Flame under Article VIII;
deed.annex_c_4: to have this deed read aloud in the Common Tongue at the Secretariat, on request;
deed.annex_c_5: to reside lawfully while a renewal is under consideration (Article XI(2)).
deed.annex_d_lead: I, the Guaranteed Person, acknowledge receipt of the Common Tongue text of Deed No. VS-18-0947 and of the Summary Leaf.
deed.annex_e_lead: Issued separately to the Guaranteed Person. Not reproduced in the Original.
